title: Schloss Mentlberg Innsbruck
highlights: Romantic fairy-tale castle designed in the style of French historicism at the foot of Mount Natters
Picturesque onion domes, oriel windows, and crenelated towers reminiscent of Loire châteaux
Quiet castle park containing mature ancient trees and the peaceful Holy Cross chapel
Sweeping panoramic views across the city of Innsbruck and the imposing Nordkette
kurzbeschreibung: Schloss Mentlberg on the western outskirts of Innsbruck is a romantic fairytale castle built in the French historicist style.
beschreibung:
Fairytale Castle on Innsbruck's Western Edge

Picturesque Schloss Mentlberg is situated on the slopes of the Natterer Berg in the Innsbruck district of Wilten-Mentlberg. Originally a medieval manor, the castle was lavishly remodelled at the end of the 19th century by Graf Heinrich von Bourbon in the style of French Loire châteaux.

Historicist Splendour in Verdant Surroundings

With its delicate turrets, gables, and ornate roof features, Mentlberg calls to mind a true Sleeping Beauty castle. While the building serves today as an educational facility, the surrounding grounds and the adjacent Mentlberger Kapelle are a popular walking destination offering splendid views of Innsbruck.
